Cast a vecvec to the form of another

Source: R/vctrs.R
vecvec_cast.Rd

vctrs treats a single-type vecvec (whose elements all have one type) as a vector of that type, and a mixed-type vecvec as a vector of any types. vecvec_cast() casts x to the vctrs type of to, a vecvec of the same class: the values of x are cast to the type of a single-type to (with vctrs::vec_cast(), so this errors for values that can't be cast), and are kept as they are for a mixed-type to.

vecvec_cast(x, to, ...)

Arguments

x, to

Vecvecs of the same class.

...

Passed on to vctrs::vec_cast().

Value

A vecvec of the class of x, of the vctrs type of to.

Details

This applies to vecvec() and to every subclass. A vec_cast() method that a subclass registers itself between two of its vectors must return the result of vecvec_cast(), as vctrs needs the result to have the form of to when combining vectors. (Methods registered by vecvec_register() do this already.)

Examples

# To a single type
vecvec_cast(vecvec(1:3), vecvec(0.5))
#> <double*[3]>
#> [1] 1 2 3

# Any types
vecvec_cast(vecvec(1:3), vecvec(1, "a"))
#> <integer*[3]>
#> [1] 1 2 3
